base_observation: WP307 owns the typed-memory persistence adapter. This packet modifies no WP307-owned source, test, workflow, receipt or reconciliation path.

falsifiers.setup: Provide a CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore already bound to canonical UnifiedDB A. Make a writable SQLite B available by path and/or ATTACH. Exercise the typed-memory adapter.
falsifiers.required_result: All WP307 schema and row writes occur only in main on the exact already-bound UnifiedDB A; B remains byte/schema unchanged.
falsifiers.product_negative_if: Adapter opens, creates or writes any second SQLite database or attached schema for typed memory.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Directly tests the one-canonical-state-authority invariant rather than merely checking a configured pathname.

falsifiers.setup: After authority resolution/fingerprint but before a persistence operation, replace the canonical DB pathname with another valid SQLite file/inode while preserving the path string.
falsifiers.required_result: Fail closed under the existing WP206/UnifiedDB identity fence; no canonical-memory-write credit and no silent write to replacement identity.
falsifiers.product_negative_if: Path equality alone is treated as canonical identity after device/inode replacement.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Prevents the thin adapter from weakening the exact file-identity guard already enforced by CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore.

falsifiers.setup: Persist the exact same TypedMemoryRecord twice with identical memory_id, lifecycle generation, canonical record JSON and record digest.
falsifiers.required_result: One canonical row identity only; second exact replay is deterministic/idempotent and cannot create duplicate authority.
falsifiers.product_negative_if: Duplicate rows, generation inflation, second admission identity or changed receipt digest arise from exact replay.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Separates durable readback from duplicate-authority minting.

falsifiers.setup: After one accepted row, submit the same durable row identity/memory identity and lifecycle generation with a different TypedMemoryRecord canonical payload/digest.
falsifiers.required_result: Fail closed as identity/content conflict; original row remains exactly readable and unchanged.
falsifiers.product_negative_if: INSERT OR REPLACE/upsert semantics silently overwrite accepted memory identity.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Blocks a common SQLite convenience pattern from converting replay into history rewrite.

falsifiers.setup: Persist a record, mutate one stored canonical field or stored canonical JSON directly via a second connection, then use the adapter readback path.
falsifiers.required_result: Digest/canonical-form verification rejects the row; canonical-memory readback credit is not retained for the tampered observation.
falsifiers.product_negative_if: Readback validates only primary-key presence or trusts a stored digest without recomputing exact canonical record identity.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Proves readback semantics, not merely successful INSERT.

falsifiers.setup: Force a deterministic exception after schema/row work begins but before the adapter reports success, including a constraint/tamper path.
falsifiers.required_result: Transaction rollback leaves no partially authoritative typed-memory row or acceptance receipt state.
falsifiers.product_negative_if: A partial row survives a failed operation or adapter commits caller-owned unrelated transaction work.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Checks atomicity and prevents success-shaped residue after failure.

falsifiers.setup: After repository acceptance, close all writer connections, start a fresh process, re-resolve/fingerprint the same canonical UnifiedDB file and read the exact TypedMemoryRecord.
falsifiers.required_result: Only this external/fresh-process exact readback may promote target-environment persistence scope; repository same-process readback remains component evidence only.
falsifiers.product_negative_if: Repository CI or same-connection SELECT is relabeled as target-runtime durable-memory persistence.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Protects evidence depth and the planned VPS promotion boundary.

acceptance_guidance: WP307 should reuse the already-bound CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore/main connection or an equivalently exact admitted UnifiedDB handle; it must not open a convenience database. Persist an immutable canonical TypedMemoryRecord representation plus recomputable digest, make exact replay idempotent, reject identity/content collision and tampered readback, and keep repository evidence distinct from fresh-process VPS evidence.
next_exact_action: WP307 mutation owner consumes TMDB01-TMDB06 in repository regressions before repository acceptance. Only after exact-source CI passes should TMDB07 be exercised on the admitted VPS route with fresh-process readback and exact file identity.
